payload.evidence_against: T038 selected its fixed weight on only 20 primary wells; the ten observable edge wells remain very difficult at 21.635 RMSE; the public source implementation cannot enter deployment; and PF-specific destructive controls were not part of the T038 contract.
payload.evidence_for: The sequential likelihood-PF is materially different from E005/E006's bounded datum/toe particle grid. T038 PF standalone reaches 6.3041 and the frozen 0.75 PF blend reaches 6.1144, gains 6.7982 versus E011, wins every fold stratum, improves p90 and worst-20% concentration, improves the edge panel, runs deterministically, and projects to about 0.60 hours for 773 wells.
payload.next_test: Implement E013 without importing or executing public source code; verify score-blind parity on three wells, freeze the implementation, then run all 773 wells and the registered 100-well PF control panel exactly once.
payload.statement: A clean-room sequential likelihood-weighted particle filter blended at the frozen 0.75 weight with E011 will retain multi-RMSE value on all 773 wells and can reach at most 8 RMSE, with sub-6 as the breakthrough target, while surviving PF-specific causality and robustness controls.
payload.title: Clean-room likelihood PF transfers the T038 gain
